ModMetaData.name: Universal Squeaker
ModMetaData.author: Coahuilite
ModMetaData.description:
为任何种族接入语音包的通用内核。Universal Squeaker 本身不含任何语音内容：它提供路由表（把第三方语音包按种族/异种域挂到 pawn 上）、分层调音（全局/种族/异种三级覆盖）、距离衰减曲线、心情调制、彩蛋门与相机指示器，并附带 usdiag 诊断协议。启用后打开独立设置窗口，五个工作区（总览/距离/语音包/调音/预设）+ 右侧悬停帮助面板引导配置。需要前置模组 FerriteLib。
Universal Squeaker is a voice-pack routing kernel for any race. It ships no audio itself: it provides a routing table (attaching third-party voice packs to pawns by race/xenotype domain), layered tuning (global/race/xenotype overrides), distance attenuation curves, mood modulation, easter-egg gating, and a camera indicator — with a built-in usdiag diagnostics protocol. Open the dedicated settings window: five workspaces (Overview / Distance / Packs / Tuning / Presets) plus a hover-driven help panel guide configuration. Requires the FerriteLib prerequisite mod.
